The Sample Licensing Act, 1950 ( ACT NO. XII OF 1950 )

1. In this Act, "licence" shall mean a licence granted under section 3.

2. No person shall carry on a trade without a licence.

3. The Controller may grant a licence and shall record every licence in a register.

4. A licensee must display the licence and is required to renew it each year.

5. Whoever contravenes section 2 shall be punishable with fine which may extend to one thousand taka.
